Productivity & Notes

Productivity & Notes apps for Omarchy

5 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-19 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 5 productivity & notes packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-19.

Every productivity & notes package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • basecamp-cli omarchy pkg add basecamp-cli
    Manage your Basecamp projects, to-dos, and messages without leaving the terminal.
  • omapresent omarchy pkg add omapresent
    Write a Markdown file, get a presentation, no slide design required.
  • omawrite omarchy pkg add omawrite
    A stripped-down Markdown editor that gets out of the way and just lets you write.
  • slap-notes-bin omarchy pkg add slap-notes-bin
    Notes that link to each other and can go do research for you.
  • typora omarchy pkg add typora
    Markdown that never asks you to look at markdown.
